# Security and sensitive data

ElicitMesh is an instruction-based Skill, not a secure hosted environment. Data handling, retention, permissions and model-provider behavior depend on the runtime in which it is installed.

Do not publish genuine client matters, employment disputes, personal details or construction documents as GitHub issues. Use synthetic or suitably redacted repros.

For a security vulnerability, contact the repository maintainer through the private security reporting mechanism once the GitHub repository is created. Do not post exploits, credentials or private records publicly.
